name: Mission Valley Breakfast Company
notes: 3 photos. Photo 1 (used here) and photo 3 show the same printed food menu (Specialties/Waffles/Pancakes/French Toast/Omelets/Sides) photographed at two different times with a price increase on photo 3; merged as one menu using photo 1's prices. Photo 2 is the bar/coffee/beverage menu (Bloody Marys, cocktails, beer, coffee drinks) with no food items and was skipped. Variable-price items (e.g. Toast, single/double/triple Eggs) used the base or single-unit price; add-on modifiers (add shrimp, add chicken, etc.) were omitted.
